environment.description: Same Ktor service deployed on EKS (eu-west-1 production cluster). Split.io workspace 'prod-eu' has the 'profile-enrichment-v2' flag configured with targeting rules: the flag's default treatment is 'off', with a kill switch segment 'enrichment-rollout-segment' that currently contains 0 members. The flag's 'default rule' returns 'off' and the individual targeting list is empty. The SDK initialization uses the 'prod-eu' server-side API key which resolves against this workspace's rules. Note: the flag definition includes a percentage rollout rule but it is set to 0% for treatment 'on' and 100% for treatment 'off'. The SDK's impression listener logs all evaluations to Datadog for audit. There is no code-level override or local evaluator mode configured.
